description: Taskei P559198894 (and the reference-bodied part of T-2188): does a relative defined name's reference wrap round the grid when the using cell's offset carries it past the last row or column? A file stores a relative name anchored at A1. Above = Data!C1048576 (one row up, two columns right): from Calc!A2 it reads Data!C1 (10 with a wrap), from Calc!A5 Data!C4 (40), from Calc!A1 Data!C1048576 (empty, 0). Left = Data!XFD3 (one column left, two rows down): from Calc!B1 it reads Data!A3 (7). Blk = Grid!XER1048545:M1048554 is R[-32]C[-13]:R[-23]C[12]: from Calc!N33 it is Grid!A1:Z10 (COLUMNS 26), from N34 Grid!A2:Z11 (ROWS 10), from N35 Grid!A3:Z12 (SUM 1050: M5 50 and Z10 1000), from N36 Grid!A4:Z13 (COUNT 2); from N28 its first corner lands on row 1048572 and its second on row 5, so ROWS asks whether Excel reads A5:Z1048572 (1048568). A formula-bodied name, Twice = Data!C1048576*2, from Calc2!A2 is 20 with a wrap. The far edge: Below = Data!A2 (one row down) used on Calc2!A1048576 reads Data!A1 (5), and Right = Data!B1 (one column right) used in Calc2!XFD1 reads Data!A1 (5). The engine before any fix does not wrap: COLUMNS of the shifted block was 16,360.
